permissions.title: Read your library
permissions.description: Search and list tracks, albums, artists and playlists. File locations are never shared.

permissions.title: Read enriched metadata
permissions.description: Read MusicBrainz and Discogs identifiers, labels, genres, BPM, key and analysis data.

permissions.title: Read folder structure
permissions.description: See your library folders and where each file sits inside them, as paths relative to each folder.

permissions.title: Suggest metadata changes
permissions.description: Suggest field changes. You review every suggestion; nothing changes until you accept it.

permissions.title: Suggest file organization
permissions.description: Prepare a rename or move plan for you to review. The plugin cannot move or rename files.

permissions.title: See what is playing
permissions.description: Read the current track, queue and playback state, and be notified when playback changes.

permissions.title: Connect to the internet
permissions.description: Make HTTPS requests to the domains listed in the manifest, and only those.

permissions.title: Store its own data
permissions.description: Keep settings and data in private storage that no other plugin can read.

permissions.title: Run background tasks
permissions.description: Run tasks in the background within the limits Tape sets. They pause while Tape is busy.

permissions.title: Add to the interface
permissions.description: Add menu items, panels, views and settings in the places listed in the manifest.

permissions.title: Show notifications
permissions.description: Show short in-app notifications.

permissions.title: Write diagnostic logs
permissions.description: Write bounded logs to its own plugin console.

permissions.title: Apply approved metadata changes
permissions.description: Apply a batch of metadata changes you approved, with undo.

permissions.title: Apply an approved file plan
permissions.description: Ask Tape to rename or move files according to a plan you approved, with undo.

permissions.title: Suggest tag writes
permissions.description: Suggest writing tags into audio files. You review every change.

permissions.title: Create and edit playlists
permissions.description: Create playlists and add tracks to playlists it created.

permissions.title: Control playback
permissions.description: Play, pause, skip and queue tracks.

permissions.title: Change how Tape looks
permissions.description: Replace colors, typography and spacing with a theme.

permissions.title: Open network connections
permissions.description: Open direct network connections. Reserved for core add-ons.

permissions.title: Music Hub Network transport
permissions.description: Use the Music Hub Network Iroh namespace. Core add-on only.

permissions.title: Music Hub Network storage
permissions.description: Use the Music Hub Network storage scope. Core add-on only.
